referents.why: First person suffix on the infinitive 'founded' (when I founded the earth): the LORD, speaking.
Second person in the question 'were you': the one addressed, Job.
Implied second person subject of the imperative 'tell': the one commanded to speak, Job.

links.why: The be-plus-infinitive 'when I founded' is a temporal adjunct nested in the question.

groups.why: The sender of 'tell me' is the LORD. The builder's sender 'cl2s' is the implied you of the command, who is Job, the addressee. The condition 'if you have understanding' belongs to the LORD's turn.
groups.category: speaker of a command to speak

cant_tell.what: What Job is commanded to tell is not stated in this verse, so the commanded turn has no content here.
cant_tell.why: Under the commanded-speech rule the words are Job's, and the text gives none in this verse.

cant_tell.what: Whether 'if you have understanding' is a condition on 'tell Me' (an if link from cl2 to cl3).
cant_tell.why: The particle is not shown in opens_with, so the form does not confirm it. No link added.
